KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.

2. When practising Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki, which approach is best? (1 mark)

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
